name: Tina Kotek
summary:
Christine "Tina" Kotek ( KOH-tek; born September 30, 1966) is an American politician and former public policy advocate who has served as the 39th governor of Oregon since 2023. A member of the Democratic Party, Kotek served from 2007 to 2022 as a member of the Oregon House of Representatives from the 44th district and from 2013 to 2022 as speaker of the Oregon House of Representatives.
Kotek became the first openly lesbian woman elected speaker of a U.S. state house in 2013.
